text: ここいらは　あったかくて　いいだろ

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: あったかくて　いい
patterns.explanation: The くて ending joins one describing word to the next, like 'and', and here also gives the reason it is nice. あったかくて　いい = 'nice and warm'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろ is a short だろう, which asks the listener to agree. いいだろ = 'it's nice, isn't it'.
